body:
I haven't reviewed this in detail yet. Just a couple of things I noticed:

1. You probably shouldn't touch `EditorHelp` at all (and most likely anything outside the GDScript module). GDScript should generate `PropertyInfo` and `DocData` identical to those generated by the core. There's no need to invent new `PropertyInfo` and `DocData` formats (like `BitField[...]` in the `class_name` field). Please study and use the existing formats.
2. I think you should introduce a new type kind `BITFIELD` in `GDScriptParser::DataType`, instead of the `is_bitfield` field, right after `ENUM`. Yes, this means a bit more work, but it will be more consistent and we'll be less likely to miss anything.

>You probably shouldn't touch `EditorHelp` at all (and most likely anything outside the GDScript module). GDScript should generate `PropertyInfo` and `DocData` identical to those generated by the core. There's no need to invent new `PropertyInfo` and `DocData` formats (like `BitField[...]` in the `class_name` field). Please study and use the existing formats.

Agreed. However, some are necessary for documentation to show up correctly (especially with dictionaries, which needs special logic to determine if the key or/and the value is a `BitField`), but they can definitely be improved a lot. I'll look into it.

>I think you should introduce a new type kind `BITFIELD` in `GDScriptParser::DataType`, instead of the `is_bitfield` field, right after `ENUM`. Yes, this means a bit more work, but it will be more consistent and we'll be less likely to miss anything.

Surprisingly didn't even require that many changes, and even improved some parts.

I'm running into a roadblock with showing documentation for types like `Dictionary[String, BitField[Enum]]` or `Dictionary[BitField[Enum], String]`. The first thing I tried was changing the type in `DocData`, but like you said that wouldn't match the `DocData` generated by the core, and also changes all current documentation in an extremely annoying way. The fundamental problem is that the type is stored with a `String`, which is normally fine, but for nested types, this would be pretty annoying show inside the documentation, as you need to basically dismantle the type to show proper meta. An idea I had to fix this would be to have a `Type` struct that could easily be converted to a `String`, but would hold the full type chain.

Problem is that all of this feels a bit out-of-scope for this PR, and I'm unsure of what I should do next. What's for sure though is that the current changes to documentation have to be changed.
